Faster with Windows 11, which signs every connection: the signature of SMB 2.1 costs this box about half the computing time of the one of SMB 3 (measured about 9–14 instead of 4–10 MB/s when writing). Without signing about 35 MB/s are possible. In exchange there is no SMB 3: no encryption, no multichannel. Open connections are dropped when this is changed.

Only for devices that have trouble with SMB 3. The signature Windows 11 requires on every connection is computed by the crypto engine of the box with SMB 3 (measured about 19–23 MB/s when writing, about 35 without signing); SMB 2.1 computes it on the processor (about 9–14 MB/s) and has no encryption and no multichannel. Open connections are dropped when this is changed.
